groups.reason: Names the platform defines, not Termilly: .NET's name for Linux ([SupportedOSPlatform]), DOM event names, keyboard key names, element tags and typeof results. They mean the same everywhere and a constant would only rename them.

Values DOM APIs take: where scrollIntoView puts an element and insertAdjacentHTML puts markup, Intl's date and time styles, HTML and ARIA attribute names and values, input types, CSS keywords, and the types a drag or the clipboard carries. The browser defines them; a constant would only rename them.

State classes app.css styles across the page (an open popover's anchor, a selected row, a field with a mistake). They're the stylesheet's vocabulary, shared by every component, not values of one module.
Values xterm.js defines: its buffer types (normal, or the alternate screen full-screen programs use) and its decoration layers and positions.
